s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with chronic abdominal pain and vaginal discharge
salient_findings: Pelvic mass extending to two fingers below the umbilicus
key_facts: 48-year-old postmenopausal woman
Gravida 2, para 2
3-month history of brown-yellowish vaginal discharge
Fluctuating lower abdominal pain
Fever
Progressive abdominal enlargement over 15 years
Difficulty with defecation and voiding
Previous attempted myomectomy with severe adhesions
Elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level of 115.6 g/dL
Smooth, firm pelvic mass on rectovaginal examination
Limited mobility of the pelvic mass
Cervix could not be visualized or sondaged
Transabdominal ultrasound showed a hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity
Separate homogeneous solid mass in the left adnexa
Abdominal and pelvic computed tomography demonstrated a multilocular cystic mass

shortlist.label: Infected hematometra
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of brown-yellowish vaginal discharge, fluctuating lower abdominal pain, and a smooth, firm pelvic mass, with imaging studies showing a hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity and a multilocular cystic mass

shortlist.label: Leiomyoma with cystic degeneration
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of previous attempted myomectomy with severe adhesions, and imaging studies show a separate homogeneous solid mass in the left adnexa, consistent with a leiomyoma

shortlist.label: Ovarian cystadenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level and imaging studies showing a multilocular cystic mass with thick septa and enhancing solid components, raising suspicion for a malignant ovarian tumor

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of progressive abdominal enlargement and a smooth, firm pelvic mass, with imaging studies showing a large uterine mass, which could be consistent with a uterine leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Endometrial adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of postmenopausal bleeding and a smooth, firm pelvic mass, with imaging studies showing a distended uterine cavity and a multilocular cystic mass, which could be consistent with an endometrial adenocarcinoma

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of brown-yellowish vaginal discharge, fluctuating lower abdominal pain, fever, and progressive abdominal enlargement, combined with the ultrasound and CT findings of a hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity and a multilocular cystic mass, are consistent with infected hematometra. The elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level and difficulty with defecation and voiding also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Leiomyoma with cystic degeneration
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of attempted myomectomy and severe adhesions, the current symptoms and imaging findings are more suggestive of an infected hematometra than a leiomyoma with cystic degeneration.

rejected.label: Ovarian cystadenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The imaging findings do not specifically suggest an ovarian malignancy, and the patient's symptoms are more consistent with an infected hematometra.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence to suggest a malignant uterine tumor, and the patient's symptoms and imaging findings are more consistent with an infected hematometra.

rejected.label: Endometrial adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings do not specifically suggest endometrial cancer, and the elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level can be seen in various conditions, including infected hematometra.
